column1: NOTE: We're not charting every single article:fighter combination, so please make educated guesses before cloning articles. A good rule of thumb is that any article that would need to communicate with the owner in a unique way (pkthunder, gordo, blade beam), utilizes level geometry (hydrant), comes from a DLC fighter (ray of punishment), or comes from a semiclone character (young link arrows) is most likely not going to work. Self-destruct behavior can often be changed by either hooking the common weapon on hit vtable (0x33bdc30 [13.0.3]), common weapon on shield vtable (0x346c8d0 [13.0.3]) or the weapon's specific vtable entries.
